name: Services, distribution, freight transport and building products
status: draft: tags proposed by Claude from the GICS sub-industry, the Fiscal.ai business description and segment mix; not yet reviewed by the user

waste.label: Solid and hazardous waste
waste.def: Collection, transfer, landfill, recycling and hazardous-waste disposal under long municipal and commercial contracts; landfill permits limit new entry and pricing runs above inflation.

route_services.label: Route-based recurring services
route_services.def: Uniform rental, pest control, hygiene, cleaning and facility services delivered on regular routes or under service contracts; revenue recurs, capital is mostly route vehicles and garment or product stock.

deathcare.label: Deathcare
deathcare.def: Funeral homes and cemeteries, including preneed contracts and memorialisation products; demand follows deaths, cash is collected in advance through preneed trusts.

mro_dist.label: Industrial MRO distribution
mro_dist.def: Distributors of maintenance, repair and operating supplies, fasteners, bearings, electrical and industrial products to manufacturers, contractors and institutions.

bldg_dist.label: Building, HVAC and water distribution
bldg_dist.def: Distributors of HVAC equipment, plumbing, waterworks, pool, landscape and lumber products to contractors; earnings follow replacement demand and new construction.

health_dist.label: Healthcare distribution
health_dist.def: Wholesale distributors of pharmaceuticals and medical or dental supplies to pharmacies, hospitals and practices; thin margins on very large revenue, little capital per dollar of sales.

rail.label: Freight railroads
rail.def: North American Class I freight railroads: own track, yards and locomotives; carry bulk, merchandise and intermodal freight with high fixed costs and long-lived assets.
rail.complete_why: all five listed North American Class I freight railroads (BNSF is owned by Berkshire Hathaway); marked 2026-10-27

truck.label: Trucking, LTL and intermodal
truck.def: Less-than-truckload carriers, truckload fleets, intermodal and asset-light freight brokers; earnings follow industrial freight volumes and pricing.

bldg_products.label: Building products
bldg_products.def: Makers of roofing, insulation, siding, decking, drainage, fixtures, HVAC equipment and structural building products sold through distributors and contractors.
